plain_statement: It is false that: Petersen graph as in the parent, F its edge function on 10 inputs. Take any fan-in-two gate g on the 10 inputs and any AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit of at most 17 gates reading the 10 inputs and the wire of g: if two of its wires are each true somewhere the other is false and both are false wherever F is false, some input makes F true with both false.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Petersen graph: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 19 gates computes its edge function
